mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to increase borrowing and investment, thereby boosting equity markets and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with low FEDFUNDS levels, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A moderate unemployment rate suggests a stable labor market, which is conducive to economic growth and positive equity returns. The current UNRATE of 5.5% is within a range that historically supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with moderate UNRATE levels, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenues and equity prices. When RSAFS growth exceeds 5% year-over-year, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth exceeds 5% YoY but the S&P 500 returns are not positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects expanding economic activity and consumer confidence, which supports equity market growth. When HOUST exceeds 900,000 units, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST exceeds 900,000 units but the S&P 500 returns are not positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and equity prices. When INDPRO growth exceeds 4% year-over-year, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth exceeds 4% YoY but the S&P 500 returns are not positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports economic growth and equity prices. This joint condition predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS occurs but the S&P 500 returns are not positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and high real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust economic activity, which supports equity market growth. This joint condition predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY and RSAFS growth > 5% YoY
failure_condition: If the joint condition of strong GDPC1 and RSAFS growth occurs but the S&P 500 returns are not positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) during a late-cycle expansion indicates reduced economic activity, which can lead to negative equity market returns. This mechanism is regime-specific to late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows but the S&P 500 returns remain positive, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.
